pages.title: Totem Wrench
text: Every machine in the camp faces somewhere, and sooner or later it faces the wrong way. Use the wrench on a block and it turns in place, without breaking and replacing it. Logs and pillars roll to their next axis.
**Sneak-use a machine's face** and that face steps through Both, Input, Output and Closed — the same setting the machine's own side pad shows, reachable from outside the screen.
On [song plates](song_plates) it syncs instead of turning: crouch-use one plate to hold its song, then use another to make it hear the first with no wire between.

pages.title: What it costs and refuses
text: A turn takes **1 Pulse** from any cell you carry. With no Pulse on you the wrench wears a point of its **512** instead, so it still works on a bad day.
A wall torch, ladder or lever steps round to the next wall that will hold it, and stays put if there is none.
It will not turn a block that is really two: a bed, a door, a double chest, a tall plant, or an **extended piston** and its head. Retract the piston first.

It respects protected land, and it refuses machines placed by someone outside your camp, same as an empty hand would: it still reads another camp's song plates, but will not sync them or hold their songs.

pages.title: Weaver's Wand
text: Click the face of a block and the wand carries that face outward across every neighbour like it: up to **32 blocks** in one sweep, laid against the side you clicked.

The blocks come from your pack and hotbar and cost **2 Pulse** each; each sweep wears the wand a point of its **768**. It only fills empty space, never replacing anything that is already there, so a floor is laid in a click and nothing underneath is lost.

pages.title: Where it will not lay
text: The wand skips any spot where the block could not stand (a torch with nothing to hang on, a plant on stone) and any spot in protected land, and lays the rest.
It will not copy a block that holds more than one item or keeps an inventory: a double slab, a door or bed, a stack of candles or pickles, layered snow, a chest or a machine.
If you run out of blocks or Pulse partway, the sweep simply stops there.
